anya: quick ping  my PR for the 'Transient Errors & Context Eviction' guide flaked snippet CI. The golden output differs between runs: sometimes the example shows `429` and other times it shows `stream EOF` or an 'eviction' warning. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/614

marcos: can you paste the failing snippet link from CI?

anya: ci link: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/614. The python example that demonstrates fallback-to-condensed-template produced different console lines across runs which breaks the narrative.

jen: runtime FYI  when the KV prefix is evicted we emit a lightweight warning on responses; under extreme load the runtime may close the stream instead of returning 429. Docs should show a single check that normalizes these transient signals.

samir: suggestion: introduce a tiny helper `normalizeTransientError(err)` that returns `{shouldRetry, reason}` in prose, and show language snippets that call it. Keep helper intentionally simple so readers can copy. Example (py pseudo):

```
def normalizeTransientError(err, headers):
    if headers.get('retry-after'):
        return True, 'retry-after'
    if getattr(err, 'status', None) == 429:
        return True, '429'
    if getattr(err, 'code', None) == 'STREAM_EOF' or headers.get('x-rw-evict'):
        return True, 'stream-or-evict'
    return False, None
```

marcos: nice. let's also call out idempotency: don't auto-retry non-idempotent writes unless an idempotency key is present. Short checkbox in the guide should cover that.

jen: agree. also propose a 3-case micro-eval: (1) immediate 429 with Retry-After, (2) stream EOF, (3) success. Set expected console lines so CI goldens are stable.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: 1 mismatch on run 2. CI: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/614. Recommendation: add deterministic seeds and explicit expected lines in micro-eval.

anya: I'll add the helper and the micro-eval YAML to the PR tonight, include expected logs. marcos  can you review the idempotency blurb?

marcos: will review. tiny wording nit: prefer "prefer idempotency keys for writes; otherwise surface retry suggestion".

snippet-ci: holding publish until micro-eval added and snippets stabilize.

anya: thanks all 64f I'll push the update and tag reviewers. Once snippet CI is green we'll merge and link the runbook entry for "transient errors" in the error-ref.
